chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 295: A Way Out – Li Huowang's Body Betrays Him
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tries to recover from his wounds, but a tentacle from the Black Tai Sui and a secret from Bai Lingmiao's Great Spirit remind him that peace is a luxury he cannot afford.
og_title: A Way Out – Chapter 295 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: A quiet meal, a hidden tentacle, and a spirit's secret—Li Huowang's body is no longer his own.
twitter_title: Ch. 295: A Way Out – The Black Tai Sui is evolving
twitter_description: Li Huowang pulls a tentacle from his own nose and decides it's a small price to pay for sanity. That's not a good sign.

lore_anchors.definition: The "Red Middle" tile in Mahjong, used here as a Zuowandao's alias. A name from a game of chance, mocking the idea of fixed identity.
Bai Lingmiao's Second Spirit (Er Shen), a veiled entity with long black fingernails that acts as her supernatural partner, with its own will and secrets.
A parasitic entity that suppresses Li Huowang's hallucinations when consumed, but its growing agency within his body is becoming a new threat.
An alchemical pill that extends or replenishes one's lifespan; a rare and valuable resource in the Dao-Twisted World.
